invalid_credentials.suggestion: Check your details and try again

email_exists.suggestion: Log in instead of creating a new account

not_authenticated.message: You must be logged in to access this service

token_expired.suggestion: Refresh the session or log in again

forbidden.message: You do not have permission to perform this action
forbidden.suggestion: Ask the account owner to grant you access

no_tenant.message: Your account is not linked to any company
no_tenant.suggestion: Ask the company owner to add you

not_member.message: You are not a member of this company

trn_exists.message: This TRN is already registered to another company
trn_exists.suggestion: Check the number, or contact support if this is your TRN

asp_already_registered.message: Peppol registration is already in progress or completed

invalid_period.message: '{value}' is not a valid period — use the YYYY-MM format

buyer_trn_not_registered.message: The buyer's TRN is not registered with the FTA ({code})
buyer_trn_not_registered.suggestion: Verify the buyer's TRN with your customer, correct it, then resend

supplier_trn_not_registered.message: Your TRN is not registered with the FTA ({code})
supplier_trn_not_registered.suggestion: Check your tax registration status in your company settings

totals_inconsistent.message: The invoice totals were rejected as inconsistent ({code})
totals_inconsistent.suggestion: Re-check line amounts, discounts and VAT, then resend

vat_breakdown_invalid.suggestion: Check the VAT category and rate on each line, then resend

receiver_unreachable.message: The buyer could not be reached on the Peppol network ({code})
receiver_unreachable.suggestion: Confirm the buyer's electronic address, or try again later

schema_invalid.message: The invoice document failed schema validation ({code})
schema_invalid.suggestion: Contact support — this indicates a system problem, not a data problem

unknown.suggestion: Review the rejection details and contact support if unclear

already_exists.message: This user is already a member of the company

trn_exists.message: A contact with this TRN already exists
trn_exists.suggestion: Search your contacts for the existing entry instead of creating a duplicate

file_unsupported.message: Unsupported file type: '{filename}' — upload a .csv or .xlsx file

file_empty.message: The file contains no data rows

too_many_rows.message: The file exceeds the limit of {limit} rows
too_many_rows.suggestion: Split the file and import it in batches

column_missing.message: Mapped column '{column}' was not found in the file
column_missing.suggestion: Check the column mapping against the file's header row

bad_date.message: '{value}' is not a valid date in the format {expected_format}
bad_date.suggestion: Adjust the date format in the mapping or fix the cell

vat_value_unknown.suggestion: Add it to the VAT value mapping (e.g. "5%" → standard rate)

inconsistent_invoice.message: Rows of the same invoice carry different values for '{column}'
inconsistent_invoice.suggestion: All rows of one invoice must share the same header values

template_name_exists.message: A mapping template with this name already exists
template_name_exists.suggestion: Choose a different name or delete the old template first

invalid.suggestion: Check the code sent to your phone

trn_invalid.message: The TRN must be exactly 15 digits
trn_invalid.suggestion: Enter the number exactly as it appears on your tax registration certificate

password_weak.message: Password must be at least {min_length} characters

number_exists.message: An invoice with this number already exists
number_exists.suggestion: Invoice numbers must be unique — pick the next free number

not_editable.message: This invoice can no longer be edited (status: {status})
not_editable.suggestion: Use the fix-and-resend flow for transmitted invoices

not_validatable.message: This invoice cannot be validated in its current state (status: {status})

not_sendable.suggestion: Validate the invoice first; only validated invoices can be sent

not_resendable.suggestion: Resend is only available after a rejection or a transmission error

possible_duplicate.message: Possible duplicate: an invoice with the same buyer and amount exists within 3 days ({matches})
possible_duplicate.suggestion: Check whether this invoice was already entered before sending it

type_code_unsupported.message: Invoice type code '{code}' is not supported — only 380 (commercial invoice)
type_code_unsupported.suggestion: Credit notes and other document types will be supported in a later release

currency_unsupported.message: Currency '{currency}' is not supported — invoices must be issued in AED
currency_unsupported.suggestion: Convert the amounts to AED before submitting

due_date_before_issue.message: Due date {due_date} is before the issue date {issue_date}
due_date_before_issue.suggestion: Correct the due date or the issue date

supplier_trn_missing.suggestion: Enter your 15-digit tax registration number from your company settings

supplier_trn_invalid.message: Supplier TRN '{value}' must be exactly 15 digits
supplier_trn_invalid.suggestion: Enter the number exactly as it appears on the tax registration certificate

buyer_trn_missing.suggestion: Ask your customer for their 15-digit tax registration number

buyer_trn_invalid.message: Buyer TRN '{value}' must be exactly 15 digits
buyer_trn_invalid.suggestion: Enter the number exactly as it appears on the buyer's tax registration certificate

lines_empty.message: The invoice must contain at least one line

duplicate_id.message: Line ID '{line_id}' is used more than once
duplicate_id.suggestion: Give every invoice line a unique ID

quantity_invalid.message: Quantity must be greater than zero (got {actual})

discount_invalid.message: Discount must be between zero and the line amount (got {actual})

vat_rate_mismatch.message: VAT rate {actual}% does not match category '{category}' (expected {expected}%)
vat_rate_mismatch.suggestion: Use 5% for standard-rated lines and 0% for zero-rated, exempt and reverse-charge lines

exemption_reason_missing.message: An exemption reason is required for category '{category}' lines
exemption_reason_missing.suggestion: State why this line is exempt or subject to reverse charge

line_net_mismatch.message: Line net amount {actual} does not match quantity × price − discount = {expected}
line_net_mismatch.suggestion: Correct the line amount or the quantity, price and discount

line_vat_mismatch.message: Line VAT amount {actual} does not match the computed VAT {expected}
line_vat_mismatch.suggestion: Correct the VAT amount or the line values

total_excl_mismatch.message: Total excluding VAT {actual} does not match the sum of line amounts {expected}
total_excl_mismatch.suggestion: Correct the total or the invoice lines

total_vat_mismatch.message: VAT total {actual} does not match the computed VAT {expected}
total_vat_mismatch.suggestion: Correct the VAT total or the invoice lines

total_incl_mismatch.message: Total including VAT {actual} does not match the computed total {expected}
total_incl_mismatch.suggestion: Correct the total or the invoice lines
